issues.description: In problem_statement.md (UML diagram), Lecture.getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() is specified to return int, but the solution implementation defines public double getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() and the template hint explicitly says the return type should be double. This cross-artifact mismatch makes the required method signature unclear and can cause signature-based tests/compilation to fail depending on what the grader expects.
issues.suggestedFix: Choose a single return type and align all artifacts. If the intended behavior is precise division, update the UML in problem_statement.md to getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(): double (and adjust any wording accordingly). Otherwise, change the template hint and solution method signature/implementation to return int (define rounding/truncation behavior).
